name: FGVC12 All Trays Combined (95 Classes)
source_note: Combines all instruments from Eye Vitrectomy (41), Minor Laparotomy (38), and Major Laparotomy (34) trays (Atabuzzaman et al. CVPRW 2025). 18 instruments are shared between Minor and Major. Major lap instruments have local images; eye and minor lap images pending download.

evidence_sources.label: Atabuzzaman et al. CVPRW 2025 supplementary material
supports: Full 95-class list organized by surgery type.

evidence_sources.label: FGVC12 Google Drive dataset folder
supports: Major laparotomy images (2 views per instrument). Eye and minor tray images pending.
